author: t. j. gough
title: Baylor men's tennis to face Utah in first round of Big 12 Championship
text:
Baylor men’s tennis will begin its postseason by playing Utah in the first round of the Big 12 Tournament on April 16 at the USTA National Campus. Baylor is seeded third, while Utah holds the sixth seed for this year’s tournament.
The match marks the start of tournament play for both teams. Baylor enters with a record of 21-8 overall and a conference mark of 6-2, coming off a split doubleheader against TCU and UTRGV. The Bears lost to TCU but ended their regular season with a strong win over UTRGV. In recent history, Baylor has defeated Utah in their last four meetings, including a 4-1 victory at the Hurd Tennis Center.
Utah comes into the tournament with an overall record of 7-15 and a conference record of 2-6. The Utes are currently on a two-game winning streak after victories over Idaho and BYU, closing out their regular season by edging BYU in a close match decided by one point. The Utah roster does not feature any nationally ranked players.
Baylor’s lineup includes three highly ranked athletes: Devin Badenhorst at No. 8 nationally, Zsombor Velcz at No. 44, and Connor Van Schalkwyk at No. 50.
Fans interested in following the action can watch matches on ESPN+ or find additional information about matches and brackets on the Big 12 website.
The outcome of this opening-round match will determine which team advances further into postseason play.
